svg.title: The sketch window
svg.desc: Numbered parts of the main window.
svg.text: Main toolbar - file, edit, arrange, align, snap, zoom
Tool palette - two columns, fill / stroke wells at the bottom
Rulers - drag from one to make a guide
Canvas - the page (artboard) on the pasteboard
Status bar - hint for the tool, pointer, size, color mode, zoom
Selection frame - handles to move, resize, rotate
Fill and stroke wells: click one to choose which the Color panel edits
